name: Soundgarden

whyMatters.en: Seattle band formed in 1984. Kept 1970s hard-rock riff writing inside the grunge era; Badmotorfinger (1991) and Superunknown (1994) are the peak pair.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图乐队，1984 年成立。在 grunge 时期保留 70 年代 hard-rock riff 写法；《Badmotorfinger》（1991）与《Superunknown》（1994）是巅峰双专。

note.en: From Superunknown; ballad-riff hybrid; heavy MTV play.
note.zh: 出自《Superunknown》；谣曲与 riff 混合；MTV 高曝光。

note.en: From Badmotorfinger; drop-tuned riff and Cornell high vocal.
note.zh: 出自《Badmotorfinger》；降调 riff 与 Cornell 高音人声。

note.en: Odd-meter track; street percussion cameo on Superunknown.
note.zh: 奇数拍作品；《Superunknown》上有街头打击客串。

interviewQuotes.text: We were a hard-rock band that happened to be from Seattle.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kim Thayil

interviewQuotes.text: Odd meters aren't prog. They're just how the riff wants to sit.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Matt Cameron

lyricQuotes: Times are gone for honest men

shortBio.en: Cornell–Thayil Seattle grunge/hard-rock, 1984–97 and 2010–17. Superunknown is the mass peak.
shortBio.zh: Cornell–Thayil 的西雅图 grunge/hard-rock，1984–97 与 2010–17。《Superunknown》是大众峰值。

body.en:
Soundgarden formed in Seattle in 1984. Early releases on Sub Pop preceded a major-label period. Badmotorfinger (1991) uses odd meters and drop tunings; Superunknown (1994) brought Black Hole Sun to MTV. The band split in 1997 and reunited 2010–17.

Drop tunings, Thayil’s riff writing, and Cornell’s wide vocal range keep Sabbath/Zeppelin hard-rock weight inside the Seattle grunge catalog.

Cornell, Kim Thayil, and Hiro Yamamoto started in 1984. The name comes from A Sound Garden, a sculpture at Seattle’s Sand Point that roars when the wind hits the pipes. Scott Sundquist joined so Cornell could leave the kit. Matt Cameron, from Skin Yard, replaced Sundquist; both bands appear on a 1986 CZ Records compilation. Screaming Life (1987) and Fopp (1988) came out on Sub Pop, Nirvana’s first label. Ultramega OK (1988) is on SST. The same year they signed to A&M. The book calls them the first grunge band on a major. Louder Than Love (1989): the entry says it prompted Kirk Hammett to write Enter Sandman.

Yamamoto went back to school. Jason Everman, from Nirvana, played bass, then Ben Shepherd, for Badmotorfinger (1991), issued two weeks after Nevermind. A Guns N’ Roses tour followed; that camp’s nickname in the book is Frowngarden. Superunknown (1994) hit US #1, with Black Hole Sun and Spoonman. They played the 1996 Lollapalooza second stage and split in 1997. Cornell’s gap includes Audioslave with the Rage Against the Machine instrumental trio, while Cameron joined Pearl Jam. A secret Seattle show and Lollapalooza 2010 preceded a sixth album at the end of 2012.
body.zh:
Soundgarden 于 1984 年在西雅图成立。早期在 Sub Pop 发行，后转大厂。《Badmotorfinger》（1991）多用奇数拍与降调；《Superunknown》（1994）把《Black Hole Sun》送上 MTV。1997 年解散，2010–17 重聚。

降调、Thayil 的 riff 写法与 Cornell 的宽音域，使 Sabbath/Zeppelin 式 hard-rock 重量留在西雅图 grunge 目录里。

Cornell、Kim Thayil 与 Hiro Yamamoto 1984 年组建。名字来自西雅图砂点的雕塑 A Sound Garden，风穿过管子时会响。Scott Sundquist 加入，Cornell 才能离开鼓位。Skin Yard 的 Matt Cameron 接替 Sundquist；两支乐队都出现在 1986 年 CZ Records 的合辑上。《Screaming Life》（1987）与《Fopp》（1988）由 Sub Pop 发行，这也是 Nirvana 的第一家厂牌。《Ultramega OK》（1988）在 SST。同年他们签给 A&M。书中称他们是第一支签到大厂牌的 grunge 乐队。《Louder Than Love》（1989）：条目写这张唱片促使 Kirk Hammett 写出《Enter Sandman》。

Yamamoto 回学校。来自 Nirvana 的 Jason Everman 先弹贝斯，然后是 Ben Shepherd，专辑《Badmotorfinger》（1991）在《Nevermind》两周后发行。随后与 Guns N’ Roses 巡演；书中写对方称他们为 Frowngarden。《Superunknown》（1994）美国榜首，单曲有《Black Hole Sun》与《Spoonman》。1996 年 Lollapalooza 他们在第二舞台，1997 年解散。Cornell 的空档包括与 Rage Against the Machine 乐器组组成的 Audioslave，同时 Cameron 加入 Pearl Jam。2010 年西雅图秘密演出和同年 Lollapalooza 之后，2012 年年底有第六张录音室专辑。

title.en: Hard-rock riffs in the grunge years

body.en:
Soundgarden kept Sabbath- and Zeppelin-weight riffs while other Seattle peers leaned toward punk dirt or folk-angled anxiety. Cameron often used odd meters; Thayil favored drop tunings.

On the charts they sat under the grunge label; the arrangements still read as metal-adjacent hard rock.
body.zh:
Soundgarden 保留 Sabbath、Zeppelin 重量的 riff，同时其他西雅图同辈更偏朋克脏感或民谣向焦虑。Cameron 常用奇数拍；Thayil 偏好降调。

上榜时归在 grunge 名下；编曲仍可读作邻近 metal 的 hard rock。

body.en:
Hiro Yamamoto played bass in the early years. The peak studio lineup is Cornell, Thayil, Shepherd, and Cameron on Badmotorfinger through Down on the Upside.

That four is the usual citation for the MTV years.

Sub Pop is the shared early label with Nirvana. The Guns N’ Roses tour sits on Badmotorfinger. Audioslave is Cornell with Morello, Wilk, and Commerford.
body.zh:
早期贝斯为 Hiro Yamamoto。巅峰录音编制是 Cornell、Thayil、Shepherd 与 Cameron，覆盖《Badmotorfinger》到《Down on the Upside》。

MTV 时期通常引用这四人。

Sub Pop 是与 Nirvana 共用的早期厂牌。与 Guns N’ Roses 的巡演挂在《Badmotorfinger》上。Audioslave 是 Cornell 加上 Morello、Wilk、Commerford。

alt.en: Chris Cornell and Kim Thayil with Soundgarden, 2015

body.en:
Cornell: wide vibrato and high belt. Thayil: Guild/Gibson drop tunings and wah color. Shepherd: melodic distorted bass. Cameron: odd-meter pockets (later also in Pearl Jam).

Roles are specialized; the singles still carry clear hooks.
body.zh:
Cornell：宽颤音与高喊。Thayil：Guild/Gibson 降调与哇音色。Shepherd：偏旋律的失真贝斯。Cameron：奇数拍律动（后来也在 Pearl Jam）。

分工明确；单曲仍带清楚钩子。

body.en:
Chromatic riff, tempo shifts, and Cornell’s high vocal mark Badmotorfinger. Johnny Cash later covered it, which kept the song in a wider catalog conversation.

It is a main pre-Superunknown face track.
body.zh:
半音 riff、速度换挡与 Cornell 高音人声是《Badmotorfinger》的标记。Johnny Cash 后来翻唱，使这首歌进入更广的曲目讨论。

它是《Superunknown》前的主要门面曲之一。

body.en:
Psychedelic chord color, quieter verse, large chorus. The video’s heavy MTV rotation made Superunknown hard to miss in 1994.

It is the softest mass face of a heavy-leaning band.
body.zh:
迷幻和弦色彩、较轻主歌、大副歌。录像在 MTV 的高轮播使《Superunknown》在 1994 年难以被忽略。

这是偏重型乐队里最软的大众面孔。

title.zh: 西雅图四大中的 hard-rock 席位

body.en:
Often listed with Nirvana, Pearl Jam, and Alice in Chains as the Seattle Big Four. Later hard-rock and post-grunge acts cite Thayil’s tunings and Cornell’s range; Queens of the Stone Age is one frequent reference point.

The lasting mark is drop-tuned riff craft under a grunge-era label.
body.zh:
常与 Nirvana、Pearl Jam、Alice in Chains 并称西雅图四大。后来的 hard-rock 与后 grunge 乐队常引用 Thayil 的调弦与 Cornell 的音域；Queens of the Stone Age 是常见参照之一。

持续标记是 grunge 标签下的降调 riff 写法。

note.en:
Peak studio and MTV years.

Sundquist is the first extra drummer. Everman is the bass between Yamamoto and Shepherd. Cameron later splits time with Pearl Jam.
note.zh:
巅峰录音与 MTV 时期。

Sundquist 是第一位专任鼓手。Everman 是 Yamamoto 与 Shepherd 之间的贝斯。Cameron 后来与 Pearl Jam 重叠。

note.en: MTV-era single that fixed Superunknown’s mass ID.
note.zh: MTV 时期单曲；固定《Superunknown》的大众识别。

note.en: Drop-tuned hard-rock writing under a grunge-era label.
note.zh: Grunge 年代标签下的降调 hard-rock 写法。
